segments.comment: Normal mode: the hero picks up an unpaid potion in a D:2 general store, then attacks the adjacent keeper, who kills him. shk.c inherits() takes the "takes" arm without "comes and", appended beside the pending "You die..." in end.c really_done(). Same route as unpaid-death-normal-mode-keeper-away. Seed 41190016 is the only one of 41190001-41190100 for which a port-only scan found a route of at most 30 steps to the D:1 downstairs and at most 45 steps on D:2 to a single shop object beside a wall, away from the keeper.
